content.title: What are irrigation ditches?
content.summary: Irrigation ditches were originally built as early as the 1860’s to convey water rights to farms and ranches. Now irrigation ditches deliver water for a variety of users. Most ditches run water from April through October with some that run water year-round to fill reservoirs.
